description: A React functional component named TenantSelection that displays a list of tenants fetched from an API, allows the user to select one, and navigates to the dashboard. It manages loading and error states, and uses utility functions for API interactions and tenant ID normalization.

methods.name: TenantSelection()
methods.description: React functional component that renders tenant selection UI, fetches tenants on mount, handles selection and navigation.

methods.name: load()
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches tenant data when the component mounts.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a tenant, calls the API to set tenant, and redirects to dashboard.
